meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 6 步带你在已有的 AKS 集群上把模型跑起来:验证集群、装控制器和 CRD、评估 GPU、选装推理引擎(KAITO、Dynamo、KubeRay)、部署第一个模型、冒烟测试并总结。每步先报告状态,动手前征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你要求「setup AI Runway」「install AI Runway」「deploy model to AKS」这类任务,或想从某一步续做时接管。前提是已有 AKS 集群,没有则先交给 azure-kubernetes 技能。

say.text: 帮我在这台 AKS 集群上装好 AI Runway 控制器
say.note: 从第 2 步装 CRD 和控制器。

say.text: 评估一下我的 GPU 能跑哪种模型
say.note: 检测 GPU 型号并标出精度限制。

say.text: 跳过前面的步骤,从第 4 步开始装推理引擎

howto.what_en: Six steps on an existing AKS cluster: verify the cluster, install the controller and CRDs, assess GPUs, install an inference provider, deploy a first model, then summarize. It asks for confirmation before any install or deploy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up AI Runway, install the controller, or deploy a model to AKS, or to resume from a given step. Needs an existing AKS cluster, else it hands off to azure-kubernetes.
